movement.instructions: Choose dodge_left if an enemy above Mario is within 48 pixels horizontally (above_enemy_dx between 0 and 48). Otherwise back left only if wall_distance_px is at most 8 and wall_height is greater than headroom. Otherwise run right. Null means no object.

criteria.run_right: No impassable wall within 8 pixels. Move right.
criteria.brake_left: Wall is at most 8 pixels away and taller than headroom. Back left.
criteria.dodge_left: Enemy is above and within 48 pixels. Step left to let it fall safely in front.

enemy.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 16 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?

retreat_question.instructions: Has Mario dropped at least 16 pixels since he started retreating? If yes, resume right. If not, keep going left.

criteria.run_right: Yes, move right into the lower passage.
criteria.brake_left: No, continue left off the ledge.
